title: Chapter 1296 - 41: World-Destroying Demonic Power

Chapter 1296 - 41: World-Destroying Demonic Power

Chapter 1296: Chapter 41: World-Destroying Demonic Power

After ten thousand years of arduous cultivation, Lin Yuan had reached almost the pinnacle in all aspects.

Even the grand goal of opening up his own Infinite Constant Sand Particle World had been ninety-nine percent completed.

Lin Yuan had completely lost the concept of the strength of his true form in this Source World.

A thousand years ago, Lin Yuan had to spend some effort to suppress a Source Demon.

But merely within a thousand years.

Nine thousand years ago, it became much easier for Lin Yuan to suppress a Source Demon.

A mere thought and the manipulation of the outer universe sufficed.

For Lin Yuan, the only measure of his own strength.

Was the Demon God possessing Thirteenth Layer combat power.

As for the Chaos Void, the time life of the first Source World?

The true forms in these two dimensional spaces had yet to develop their own Particle Worlds.

Far from reaching peak strength.

Impossible to make an accurate assessment.

Hence, Lin Yuan had high expectations for the Demon God of this Fang Yuan World.

At least he could gain an understanding of his direct combat power gap with a Thirteenth Layer time life by engaging the Demon God.

Indeed.

It was a direct combat power gap.

For a normal Thirteenth Layer time life.

What is the most powerful means?

Physical constitution?

Secret Technique Divine Skills?

Will and soul?

None of these.

The most powerful means for a Thirteenth Layer time life compared to a Twelfth Layer and lower life is the ability to observe many future timelines.

By watching future timelines, a Thirteenth Layer time life may rarely make a move, but once it does, it is almost certain, if not entirely.

For example, the six progenitors of the first Source World.

Would never choose to stand in opposition to Lin Yuan, but rather, would try to foster good relations.

This is the greatest advantage of a Thirteenth Layer time life: from many observed timelines, it chooses the future most favorable for itself.

The Demon God of this Fang Yuan World lacks the mental will to observe future timelines.

It wouldn’t just glance at Lin Yuan and then turn around to flee.

Or hide in the dark and never show itself, depriving Lin Yuan of a direct confrontation.

...

Though Lin Yuan contemplates engaging the Demon God outright.

He wouldn’t actively seek out the Demon God, as this existence, comparable to the Thirteenth Layer, might possess hidden means.

Unless absolutely necessary, Lin Yuan does not intend to contact the Demon God before reaching the Thirteenth Layer.

Lin Yuan has always preferred overpowering the weak with strength, sweeping through obstacles.

As for the idea of the weak defeating the strong? Or even risking it all?

Too risky.

Not in line with Lin Yuan’s usual approach.

"Let me fully open the Infinite Constant Sand Particle World first."

Lin Yuan quietly thought to himself.

Opening the Infinite Constant Sand Particle World originated from Lin Yuan studying the flesh of an Abyss Dragon from the first Source World.

Coupled with the "Infinite Void" legacy from the Chaos Void, and various methods from the Rune Dao of the second Source World.

It could be considered one of the most powerful foundations at the moment.

Once the Infinite Constant Sand Particle World was fully developed, every Particle World resonating.

The unleashed power would surpass the current ninety-nine percent completion by tenfold, if not a hundredfold.

Only then would Lin Yuan have the confidence to face the Demon God directly.

Furthermore, if the Chaotic Taiji Dao is cultivated to the Third Layer.

Lin Yuan’s strength would also receive a significant boost, but compared to the development of the Infinite Constant Sand Particle World.

The Chaotic Taiji Dao in the Third Layer comes with many uncertainties.

Opening the Infinite Constant Sand Particle World only requires sufficient resources.

"Resources?"

Lin Yuan slightly furrowed his brows.

In developing the current ninety-nine percent of the Infinite Constant Sand Particle World, Lin Yuan not only hunted numerous Source Demons at the center of Heaven and Earth.

Even the foundational resources of several major Eternal Sects were almost entirely absorbed by Lin Yuan.

Since the great change of Heaven and Earth, Demonic Qi has been pervasive, and this Fang Yuan World’s many sustainable regenerative resources have been eroded by Demonic Qi.

Coupled with numerous Eternal Sects expending without replenishment over the long years.

The current storage resources of each major Eternal Sect are not plentiful.

Most have already been taken by Lin Yuan.

Of course, besides the obvious foundational resources, the major Eternal Sects.

Also have their last-resort foundational resources.

But the latter ties into the final defense methods of the Eternal Sect forces.

For instance, the vast energy needed to wield those few Eternal Treasures.

Lin Yuan felt uneasy to request those.

Given the current situation, with a Demon God potentially descending at any time.

If these last-resort resources were lost, it is uncertain whether the major Eternal Sect forces could withstand the Demon God.

"Still must rely on Source Demons."

Lin Yuan thought internally.

The complete development of the Infinite Constant Sand World would likely depend on the Source Demons.

Source Demons being immortal, those killed by Lin Yuan did not actually perish completely.

They simply retreated to another location to quickly recover.

Once the first batch of hunted Source Demons have fully recovered, Lin Yuan could commence a second round of hunting.

It’s simply a matter of waiting thousands to tens of thousands of years more.

"Hope before the Demon God descends, I can completely develop the Infinite Constant Sand Particle World."

Scenes involving the ’Demon God’ emerged in Lin Yuan’s mind.

Before the great transformation of Heaven and Earth in this Fang Yuan World, the Demon God once made an appearance.

The images from back then were recorded and duplicated by the major Eternal Sects.

Lin Yuan has watched these many times over the years.

In the images, at first, endless Demonic Qi filled the skies.

The major Eternal Sect forces, having prepared in advance, immediately activated their own Eternal Treasures, intending to dispel the Demonic Qi as quickly as possible.

In the future timelines observed by the Eternal Lords.

If all Demonic Qi could be dispelled at the first sign of a ’demonic’ disaster.
